legend: Volcanoes are erupting over the ovine homeland! Help the Sheep King escape the lava.
There are n$$$n$$$ islands connected by m$$$m$$$ undirected bridges. Each bridge has a length w$$$w$$$: crossing that bridge takes exactly w$$$w$$$ days (for both the sheep and the lava).
Each island i$$$i$$$ has a volcano that erupts on day ai$$$a_i$$$. When a volcano erupts, all bridges connected to that island burn down and become unusable.

Lava spreads through the bridge network over time, using the same travel times as the Sheep King (it needs w$$$w$$$ days to cross a bridge of length w$$$w$$$). If lava reaches an island before its volcano erupts, that island burns at the moment lava arrives.

The Sheep King starts on island 1$$$1$$$ at day 0$$$0$$$ and wants to reach island n$$$n$$$ to escape. If he arrives at an island exactly when it burns, he is considered safe and may still depart from it at that time.
input: The first line contains an integer t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤104)$$$(1 \le t \le 10^4)$$$ — the number of test cases.
The first line contains two integers n$$$n$$$ and m$$$m$$$ (1≤n≤105, 0≤m≤105)$$$(1 \le n \le 10^5,\ 0 \le m \le 10^5)$$$.
The second line contains n$$$n$$$ integers a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1,a_2,\dots,a_n$$$ (1≤ai≤109)$$$(1 \le a_i \le 10^9)$$$ — the eruption days of the volcanoes.

Each of the next m$$$m$$$ lines contains three integers xj$$$x_j$$$, yj$$$y_j$$$, and wj$$$w_j$$$ (1≤xj<yj≤n,1≤wj≤109)$$$(1 \le x_j  \lt  y_j \le n, 1 \le w_j \le 10^9)$$$ denoting an undirected bridge between islands xj$$$x_j$$$ and yj$$$y_j$$$ of length wj$$$w_j$$$.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n$$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 105$$$10^5$$$, and the sum of m$$$m$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 105$$$10^5$$$.
output: For each test case, print Yes (case-insensitive) if it is possible to travel from island 1$$$1$$$ to island n$$$n$$$. Otherwise, print No (case-insensitive).
note: The Sheep King can travel from island 1$$$1$$$ to island 2$$$2$$$ in 2$$$2$$$ days. He arrives at island 2$$$2$$$ on day 2$$$2$$$, exactly when it burns. He is still safe, so he can continue to island 3$$$3$$$ and arrive there on day 4$$$4$$$. The answer is Yes.

legend.ai: 绵羊的家园中火山正在喷发！帮助绵羊国王逃离熔岩。
有 n$$$n$$$ 座岛屿，由 m$$$m$$$ 条无向桥相连。每座桥的长度为 w$$$w$$$：通过这座桥恰好需要 w$$$w$$$ 天(绵羊和熔岩均如此)。
每座岛屿 i$$$i$$$ 上都有一座火山，会在第 ai$$$a_i$$$ 天喷发。火山喷发时，与该岛屿相连的所有桥都会烧毁并无法使用。
熔岩会随时间通过桥梁网络扩散，使用与绵羊国王相同的通行时间(通过长度为 w$$$w$$$ 的桥需要 w$$$w$$$ 天)。如果熔岩在某座岛屿的火山喷发前到达该岛屿，则该岛屿会在熔岩到达的瞬间燃烧。
绵羊国王在第 0$$$0$$$ 天从岛屿 1$$$1$$$ 出发，想要到达岛屿 n$$$n$$$ 逃生。如果他恰好在某座岛屿燃烧时到达，他将被视为安全，并且仍可在该时刻从那里出发。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 t$$$t$$$(1≤t≤104)$$$(1 \le t \le 10^4)$$$——测试用例的数量。
第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1,a_2,\dots,a_n$$$(1≤ai≤109)$$$(1 \le a_i \le 10^9)$$$——表示火山的喷发日期。
接下来的 m$$$m$$$ 行中，每行包含三个整数 xj$$$x_j$$$、yj$$$y_j$$$ 和 wj$$$w_j$$$(1≤xj<yj≤n，1≤wj≤109)$$$(1 \le x_j  \lt  y_j \le n, 1 \le w_j \le 10^9)$$$，表示连接岛屿 xj$$$x_j$$$ 和 yj$$$y_j$$$ 的长度为 wj$$$w_j$$$ 的无向桥。
保证所有测试用例的 n$$$n$$$ 之和不超过 105$$$10^5$$$，且所有测试用例的 m$$$m$$$ 之和不超过 105$$$10^5$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，如果可以从岛屿 1$$$1$$$ 到达岛屿 n$$$n$$$，则输出 Yes(不区分大小写)；否则输出 No(不区分大小写)。

note.ai: 绵羊国王可以在 2$$$2$$$ 天内从岛屿 1$$$1$$$ 前往岛屿 2$$$2$$$。他在第 2$$$2$$$ 天抵达岛屿 2$$$2$$$，恰好此时该岛燃烧起来。他仍然安全，因此可以继续前往岛屿 3$$$3$$$，并在第 4$$$4$$$ 天抵达那里。答案是 Yes。
